description: What a name of TradingView's charting library (Advanced Charts, Trading Platform) or Lightweight Charts becomes in TradeCanvas: a widget option, featureset, override key, study, drawing shape, widget or chart method, datafeed or broker member, or a resolution. Gives the TradeCanvas option, feature switch, style key, indicator id (with its defaults and line keys), drawing type (with its anchors) or call, and says plainly when there is no equivalent and what to do instead. Look up one name with 'name', or search the table with 'query'.

kind.description: What the name is: a widget 'option', a 'featureset', an 'override' key, a 'study' (indicator), a 'drawing' (shape name), a 'method' of the widget or a chart, a 'datafeed' or 'broker' member, or a 'resolution' ('60', '1D').

name.description: The name as the old library spells it: 'header_widget', 'paneProperties.background', 'Relative Strength Index', 'trend_line', 'createStudy', 'getBars', '60'.

query.description: Words to find in the table's names, targets and notes, when there is no exact name: 'volume', 'legend'.

source.description: The library the app uses now: 'tradingview' (Advanced Charts, Trading Platform; the default) or 'lightweight-charts'.

name: migration_lookup
title: Look up a TradingView name
